itemSpec.title: Freelance design contract, brand refresh
itemSpec.description: A small company needs a brand refresh and a designer has capacity next quarter. Fee is only one of the terms: the deadline, how many rounds of revisions are included, and whether the designer keeps portfolio rights are all negotiable, and the two sides value them very differently.

buyer.persona: You are buying a brand refresh for a company that has budgeted around 9,000 USD. The launch date is the thing you actually care about, far more than the fee: every week late costs you more than a few hundred dollars of fee would. You would rather not have the work shown publicly before launch, but it is not a dealbreaker.

seller.persona: You are a designer with one slot next quarter. Below about 5,500 USD the work is not worth taking. Showing the finished work in your portfolio matters a great deal to you, because it is how you win the next client, and you will trade real money for it. Tight deadlines are expensive for you; revisions are cheap.

fixedPriceBaseline.label: The designer's posted day rate, take it or leave it
